match_id: CARRICK: “THERE'S MORE TO COME!”  Man Utd_Nottingham Forest_2026-05-17_VmoeU14Yyvs
team: CARRICK: “THERE'S MORE TO COME!”  Man Utd
speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Hey guys, We'll start with Dan. Afternoon,  Michael. After that win, guaranteed third,  
we had some nice goodbyes for some  players as well. Was that, in a way,  
a dream end to it? It was a good day, yeah.  I think we were really conscious of trying to  
finish on a bit of a high. I think we have made  some really good strides as a group, as a team,  
and as a group and as a club. It is easy to get  to this stage, and I have been part of it myself,  
where that extra spark is not there. So I think  to finish like we did, for so many reasons, was a  
good day for us. Yeah, for sure. You said in your  speech after that you are hopeful there will be  
some more big moments and big goals next season.  Finally, asking again, any updates on this? Yeah,  
I am a supporter as well, so regardless of  anything, I want there to be a lot of good moments  
here. No, I think it has been pretty clear, and  from what I said a couple of days ago, really,  
I think it is the same. Over the coming days there  will be clarity in the situation. I think today  
was important about the game and getting the right  result and some individuals as well shining today.  
So whatever the news is going to be, I am sure  you will get it in a few days. Simon. Michael,  
just in terms of this season, you finished third.  That is probably as well as anybody would have  
hoped or expected, but clearly Manchester United,  third is not the aim. What needs to happen to move  
to the next level, other than buying better  players? I think there are a couple of sides  
to it. I think understanding the position we want  to get to from where we have been a little bit,  
and understanding what steps that needs to take  and what we have had to make too. I do genuinely  
think it was a really fantastic achievement to be  where we are at the moment. The players deserve  
a lot of credit for that, and I think you just  want to keep improving. As I said the other day,  
I think the closer you get to the top of the  league, the harder it gets, and you have got  
to make big steps, but it is harder to make them  big steps. So yeah, certainly evolving the group  
is one thing for sure, and that is no negative on  the group as it is now. I think you just want to  
keep pushing forward. We have got a really good  group of players that we want to keep trying to  
improve and get better. And if that is additions,  that is additions. And some of the younger players  
will be better for it again with an extra season  and experience at this club for a year. So you  
just want to keep moving forward. That is the only  thing. There is not a magic ingredient to doing  
that. It is hard work, a bit of brains and a bit  of intelligence, and a bit of having good players  
as well. Sami. Hi, Michael. Cunha, Mbeumo and  Sesko have all broken double figures now for the  
Premier League this season. Recruitment has been  very good. Do you think it is realistic for them  
next season, with more games as well, looking at  the 20-goal mark? I do not want to put figures on  
it. I just think it has been a really good first  season for all the boys coming in and getting  
judged on goals and assists. I get that from  attacking players, but I think the overall coping  
and adapting and improving as the season goes is  important. Next season, obviously different little  
bits of different challenges, and backing it up  is another challenge. But yeah, really positive  
with those players in particular, and I am sure  there is more to come. Pete. Hi, Michael. What  
have you said to Bruno in there? Because it looked  like at times he was a little bit... Yeah, it is  
a little bit chaotic down there, actually, on the  pitch and in the changing room, so we have not had  
massively much to say. It is a tricky one. I think  he has dealt with it really well, to be honest,  
because for me, watching on from the side, he  is going through at times and you are thinking,  
what is going through his head? Is he looking  for a pass? Is he looking just to score? Is he  
second guessing it? But I think he coped with  it fantastically well, and to get the moment  
today the way he did was a really nice  moment for everybody. Credit to him for that,  
because it is not easy. But he always puts himself  behind the team, the team first. Today was another  
one of those days, even though he is going to get  the praise because it is a fantastic achievement,  
obviously. Ty. Hi, Michael. We have spoken about  a lot of players since you have come in, but  
one we have not touched on is Luke Shaw. It felt  a year ago like maybe it had come to the end of  
his career, and now he has started every Premier  League game this season. How big an achievement is  
that, and can he do that again next season when  it is potentially a 68-game season? I think it  
is difficult for anybody to do, to be honest. I  think when there are so many games, it is not an  
easy thing to be able to do. Sometimes it is no  fault of your own. Unfortunately, injuries and  
things are part of football, and there are other  things that come into play. So to start every game  
is a really fantastic thing to be able to do. Next  season is a new season. There are different types  
of runs of games, so that is part of adapting. But  then that is a little bit older and experienced,  
knowing your body and managing things. He is at  that stage, Luke now, where he has got an awful  
lot of experience. He has been here for a long  time. He knows the club, he knows what it feels  
like, he knows the ups, and he has suffered  some of the more challenging times. So next  
season I think his experience will be valuable,  however many games he plays. Last question for  
Sam. Just continuing on the theme with Luke  Shaw, but also Harry Maguire, Kobbie Mainoo,  
obviously England squads are probably soon next.  Do you think Luke Shaw will deserve to be in the  
squad as well as Kobbie and Harry, who obviously  got back into the fold in March? I certainly  
think so, yeah. I have not got much sway in the  matter at all, but I certainly think so. I think,  
again, the consistency, just what he is capable of  doing, performance, the experience, his strengths,  
his attributes that he has got. For me, he is  a fantastic full-back. I think between them,  
all three of them have done their chances no harm  recently, for sure. All right, guys, thanks a lot.
title: CARRICK: “THERE'S MORE TO COME!”  Man Utd 3-2 Nottingham Forest
